title: Utilization changes cost per useful capacity unit
method: Synthetic fixed annual cost 240,000 and 100 usable capacity units. Divide by 80, 50 and 25 occupied units. Variable cost and performance differences excluded.
alt: Utilization changes cost per useful capacity unit: 80% utilization 3000 currency units/year/unit, 50% utilization 4800 currency units/year/unit, 25% utilization 9600 currency units/year/unit. Illustrative inputs.
